5232-6991-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5232-6991-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5931-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

339-647-677-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2842-5170-6132-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5434-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-1671-2638-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-7824.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3944-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

671-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2510-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3532-3761-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

1850-4693-5967.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4693-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

277-1671-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-1671-4572-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods

4826-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 3.

413-4484-4871-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

141-5231-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4311-4740-5078-5313.manaNeeded: {2} minus {1} for each 3 life you have and minus {1} if your storm count is 2 or greater
4311-4740-5078-5313.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

2080-4050-4477.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-4050-4477.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2557-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4661--39.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Doppelganger is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4661--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

2433-5641.description:
Cast Rosie Cotton by paying {2}{W}.
When Rosie Cotton enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
Rosie Cotton's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2438-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2438-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

856-2511-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2511-4321-5477.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1912-4449-4949.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4449-4949.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

1737-2034-4853.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card with mana value 2 or less exiled by Prototype Portal.
1737-2034-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying at most {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the imprinted card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

474-2034-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
The Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
Specimen Collector dies, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-2953-4687.easyPrerequisites: Dawn's Reflection attached to a basic land you control.
2757-2953-4687.description:
Activate the basic land with Dawn's Reflection attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding {1}{G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

4191-4576.description:
Cast Fleetfoot Panther without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

776-1329-4534-4966.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4534-4966.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Chrome Mox to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chrome Mox.
Cast Chrome Mox.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

721-2030-2724.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Roaring Primadox triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Repeat each turn.
